title: smilax riparia subsp. ussuriensis
intro: Smilax riparia subsp. ussuriensis, commonly known as Ussuri smilax or Ussuri catechu, is a species of flowering plant in the Smilacaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Smilax riparia subsp. ussuriensis include stimulating digestion, acting as an expectorant, and exhibiting anti-diarrheal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
